_notes: Maps program names to USASpending agency codes and prior-year omnibus bill packages. Only include true annual appropriations — NOT ceilings, mandatory totals, capital authorizations, or one-time items. priorBills lists GovInfo package IDs (newest first). searchPattern is the regex used to locate the appropriation heading in that bill's text. minAmount filters out transfer-restriction noise (in dollars).
